meta.title: Usage hub
meta.description: Adds two usage readings under the composer — the DeepSeek API balance and the OpenCode Go allowance — and one panel with the detail. DeepSeek is read from GET /user/balance with the credential named by deepseek.apiKeyEnv in this bundle's configuration (the harness credential store first, then the process environment). OpenCode Go is read from a local OpenCode server: the plugin starts the CLI for one read and stops it again, or attaches to a server you configure with opencode.baseUrl and opencode.password. Click a reading to open the panel, which shows the balance breakdown, the rolling, weekly and monthly allowance bars with their reset times, and a Refresh button. The snapshot is cached for 5 minutes (cacheTtlMs) and both providers are read over the network on refresh; turning the bundle off removes the readings and stops both reads.
